resources.string: Stored on this device and in backups. Weight comes from measurements. Standard MET estimates do not require sex, height or age.
No estimate: missing dated weight/duration or unsupported activity.
Estimated activities: %1$d of %2$d. Missing estimates are excluded.
Waiting for an accurate GPS signal. GPS works without internet; the first fix can take longer. Gaps do not add distance.
Enable precise location and GPS, then tap Resume or Start.
Recording interrupted. Saved progress is preserved. Resume explicitly.
GPS operation failed. Saved data remains available.
Recording limit reached. Finish and save.
Offline route map · no street basemap
Pause GPS recording before restoring a backup.

2024 Adult Compendium (ages 19–59), pacompendium.com. Total = MET × kg × hours; active = (MET − 1) × kg × hours. Latest weight on or before the activity date. Estimates may differ substantially for an individual, especially strength and HIIT including rests. Ranges show effort scenarios, not confidence intervals. Speed categories assume level ground; terrain, wind, incline and machine resistance are not calibrated. No heart rate is required. Outside ages 19–59, applicability is more uncertain.
Map tiles unavailable. GPS recording and the route remain available.
Online maps request the viewed area from OpenStreetMap, revealing your IP address and approximate location. The recorded route is not uploaded.
GPS starts only when you tap Start or Resume. Recording continues with a persistent notification while locked. Routes stay on this device and in backups. Online maps are optional.
Discard only this unfinished GPS activity? Saved activities and other history will remain.
